clubs.city: Cornellà de Llobregat / El Prat de Llobregat

clubs.stadium: Estadio Bahrain Victorious Nuevo Arcángel de Córdoba

clubs.note: Andorran club playing in the Spanish league system; mapped at its real ground in Encamp.
Current home is the renovated Z7 pitch, not the older José Luis Orbegozo training ground or Anoeta.
Temporary 2026–27 home on the former Can Dragó athletics infield; this is not the separate artificial-turf Camp de futbol Porta.
The current club match report places the reserve side at the Mini Estadi; the English Wikipedia season table incorrectly lists La Cerámica.
Temporary home at Ibercaja Stadium during reconstruction of La Romareda.
